svg.text: ROUND 370 · 🏆 370-FAQ, BRK-750 & 1,602-ASSERTION HISTORIC MILESTONE · SOVEREIGN CLOUD (FEDRAMP HIGH / IL6) & CROSS-DOMAIN CDS
Sovereign & Classified Cloud (FedRAMP High / DoD IL6) & Cross-Domain Solution (CDS) AI Security Guide
Bell-LaPadula High-Side Air-Gap + Cryptographic CAPCO Banner & No-Write-Down Lock vs. OSINT Injection & 3PAO Fraud (BRK-749 / BRK-750)
🚨 1. Top 3 Sovereign Cloud & Cross-Domain Attack Surfaces
① Low-to-High OSINT Injection & NOFORN Leak (BRK-749)
• Adversarial prompt inside an Unclassified (NIPRNet / IL2) OSINT
report traverses a one-way diode into a High-Side (IL6) fusion agent
• Coerces agent into reading restricted-budget SECRET//NOFORN
compartmentalized intelligence sources & collection tasking schedules
② CAPCO Portion-Marking Downgrade & Classified Spillage
• Mutates business-result to strip CAPCO classification banners
from SECRET//NOFORN to UNCLASSIFIED//REL TO PUBLIC
• Tricks High-to-Low Cross-Domain Transfer Guard into releasing
classified intelligence onto Low-Side networks (Classified Spill)
③ Spoofed FedRAMP 3PAO & SCIF Enclave Escrow Fraud (BRK-750)
• Forged FedRAMP Third-Party Assessment Organization (3PAO)
audit invoice or SCIF Tempest facility lease notice swaps IBAN
• Initiates unauthorized $5,800 compliance wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Sovereign ATO assessment funds diverted to mule account
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Sovereign Cloud & CDS Architecture
Gate 1: NSA Raise-the-Bar CDR & Typed XSD Slots
• Enforces Content Disarm & Reconstruction (CDR) across diodes;
extracts strictly typed XML/JSON slots (CAPCO Banner, Caveat Enum)
• Strictly tags untrusted=True, lane="attack"
Gate 2: Bell-LaPadula MAC & NOFORN Compartment Air-Gap
• Isolates NOFORN/SAP compartments & collection tasking schedules
in restricted-budget under Mandatory Access Control (MAC)
• Enforced via record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: High-Water-Mark Classification & No-Write-Down Lock
• Cryptographically binds CAPCO markings; enforces High-Water-Mark
taint inheritance & Two-Person Integrity (TPI) for declassification
• Enforced via untrusted-write blocking banner downgrade writes
Gate 4: Immutable 3PAO / SCIF Integrator Registry & Dual Sign
• Locks FedRAMP 3PAO & facility escrow IBANs in trust-registry
(tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment)
📊 3. Architecture Selection & Benchmark Results
Head-to-Head Sovereign Cloud & CDS Security Options:
A. Deterministic CDS Broker + MAC Air-Gap + CAPCO Lock (🏆)
✓ 100% Block on BRK-749/750 | NSA NCDSMO & DoD IL6 Ready
B. Native Sovereign Cloud IAM & Keyword Dirty-Word Guards
⚠ Vulnerable to LLM paraphrasing/encoding bypassing dirty-word lists
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Prompt Shields / Bedrock Guardrails)
⚠ Blind to Bell-LaPadula MAC lattices & CAPCO portion markings
D. Manual Air-Gap DVD/Optical Sneaker-Net & Human Redaction
✕ Days of coalition sharing latency & removable-media insider risk
🧪 Pytest Deterministic Regression (Round 370 · 1,602 Assertions!):
• Baseline Policy: Banner downgraded, NOFORN spilled & wire sent ❌
• Hardened Policy: All 5 deterministic gates blocked 100% ✅
- record-owner: Blocks reading NOFORN compartments (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks CAPCO downgrade & spill alert suppression
- restricted-data-boundary: Enforces No-Write-Down across domains
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks 3PAO/SCIF registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,800 spoofed 3PAO wire
🚀 Architect Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestones (Round 370 · 🏆 370-FAQ, BRK-750 & 1,602-Assertion Historic Milestone!)
✅ 1. Bell-LaPadula MAC & Compartment Air-Gap: Isolate NOFORN/SAP compartments from Low-to-High OSINT ingestion agents
